parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file is a plain data transfer object. The layer model puts it in the application layer, through the **/dtos/** and **/*.dto.ts patterns. It only declares the input shape of an add-order request: name, orderId and isValid. The decorators on these fields are standard ones. @IsString, @IsBoolean and @IsNotEmpty from class-validator check structure only. @ApiProperty from @nestjs/swagger adds OpenAPI schema details. Neither kind of decorator is real transport handling, and the layer model itself counts DTOs as application. The file has no persistence code, no HTTP request or response handling, no business rules and no domain logic. Its only job, defining a validated request shape, fits the application layer. The swagger decorator could be read as a small presentation concern, but in NestJS that is the normal way to write a DTO and it is not a misplaced responsibility.
